acceptance_criteria: One rule chosen; EVENTS.md and p6-ingest agree
description:
EVENTS.md server rule 4: client_ts more than 5 minutes in the future is clamped to received_at and flagged 'future'; older than 14 days is flagged 'stale' (not clamped). p6-ingest says: 'Clamp client timestamps that are in the future or older than 14 days and flag them.' Clamping stale timestamps would overwrite the real time of events queued offline for a long time, which REVIEW finding 2 exists to protect.

Filed during beads setup (prompt 01, step 8).
title: DECISION: stale client timestamps flagged only (EVENTS.md) or clamped too (p6-ingest)
